notes: Every surface whose native port is under the visual gate (#874, ADR-0118). A surface appears here before it is switched on, and docs/mobile/screens.json may only set "enabled": true when this file carries its evidence. Each entry names the web route, the contract (shared/visual/<surface>.json - the elements and properties both clients must agree on), the test that draws the app side, and the tolerances: tolerance.length is the CSS-pixel drift allowed on a box, and tolerance.pixels is the surface's recorded raster baseline - the share of the capture that differs at the best alignment, measured from the pair that passed, with the date it was recorded. The layout contract is the exact half; the baseline is what the two rasterisers (Chromium and Skia) make of the same boxes, and it fails a regression beyond it. Evidence lives in e2e/__visual__/<surface>/ and is recorded by `npm run visual:capture` (page) and the app's own visual test (screen).
